subject: Seed Sprint — credit portfolio & packaging questions
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@brightlabs.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@brightlabs.ai
Date: 2028-03-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Seed Sprint — packaging & credits question

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency and cost profile look promising for our evaluation. We’re lining up the cohort for our Seed Sprint (runs May–Jul) and have two quick packaging questions before we lock a recommendation to the founders: 

1) Can Redwood allow program stipend credits (our cohort provides a $5k stipend) to stack with the promotional onboarding credits you mentioned, or are those mutually exclusive?
2) BrightLabs is asking whether a short-term credit bridge is possible — we expect initial consumption to spike in month 1 and then normalize. Would Redwood consider a temporary top-up (one-time 10k credit) and bill the excess over the next 60 days?

If stacking is allowed and a bridge is possible, we’d like an itemized summary so I can run it by procurement (cc’d). If it helps, I can share the cohort MA P and expected usage profile.

Best,
Elaine Park
Head of Accelerator Partnerships
BrightLabs
[Attachment: SeedSprint_Cohort_Snapshot.xlsx]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@brightlabs.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-03-27T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Seed Sprint — packaging & credits question

Hi Elaine — great to meet you yesterday and thanks for the note. Quick answers up front:

- Stacking: We generally don’t stack promotional onboarding credits with third-party cohort stipends by default, because it complicates tracking and reporting for program partners. That said, we have made exceptions for strategic accelerator partners when there’s clear mutual ROI and agreed usage caps.
- Credit bridge: We can do a one-time temporary top-up (we call it a credit bridge) for new cohort spikes, with the overage invoiced or deducted over a 60-day period.

Proposal (subject to internal approval):
- One-time credit bridge: $10,000 in trial credits applied at cohort start.
- Promotional onboarding credits: $5,000 (standard onboarding promo).
- Allow stacking for BrightLabs cohorts only for the May–Jul window, capped at total consumption of $30k across all cohort members.
- 25% promotional discount on list pricing for the first 3 months for eligible accounts created under the Seed Sprint program.

I’ve attached a concise pricing overview and a short estimate of the revenue impact. If you’re comfortable, we can include the proposal in the mutual action plan and I’ll route an internal approval for the stacking exception.

Next steps I suggest:
- You share the cohort MA P and expected seat/usage counts.
- I will submit an internal exception request and get a 24–48h decision.

Thanks — I’ll follow up internally and loop you when I have sign-off.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales (Startups & Programs)
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SeedSprint_Pricing-Overview.pdf]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-03-27T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Seed Sprint — packaging & credits question / exception request

Marissa / Lauren — forwarding Elaine’s ask and my reply above. TL;DR: BrightLabs is requesting that we allow their $5k cohort stipend to stack with our $5k onboarding promo and add a one-time $10k credit bridge for month 1. They also want a short 3-month 25% promo discount on initial accounts.

Why I’m asking: BrightLabs runs ~40 participant startups in the Seed Sprint; if we allow stacking and the bridge we capture 25–40 high-quality trial accounts (likely to convert to paid within 3–6 months). This is a high-velocity channel for us and typical deal size per converting account is ~$12–18k ARR.

Requested exception (for approval):
- Permit stacking of BrightLabs stipend ($5k) with Redwood onboarding promo ($5k) for the cohort window (May–Jul).
- One-time credit bridge: $10,000 applied at cohort start (to be reconciled across accounts; see attached estimate).
- Apply a 25% promo discount on list pricing for months 0–3 for accounts created via BrightLabs (must include a signed MA P).

Impact: estimated NPV revenue reduction of ~$36k over the first 3 months across the cohort offset by anticipated conversion of 25 accounts — see attached pricing-impact-estimate.xlsx for numbers.

Please advise: approve as-is / approve with lower bridge (e.g., $5k) / decline. If you approve, I’ll send the MA P to Elaine and route the DocuSign for signature.

Thanks,
Ben
[Attachment: pricing-impact-estimate.xlsx]

- 25% discount on list pricing month 0–3 for accounts created under the MA P.
